subject: Rstudio throws an error with some samples but not others.

messages.author: c02737bb0ac0a7f0
messages.subject: Rstudio throws an error with some samples but not others.
parts:
Hello,

I'm having a problem making featureCounts run with a certain group / combination of BAM and GTF files, and I cannot seem to figure the cause of the issue.
Basically, I have RNA-seq data from human , chimpanzee and macaque, which I mapped to their respective genomes (latest builds from ENSEMBL v.92) using STAR.
I also have the most recent GTF gene annotations (also from ENSEMBL).

When I run the human or chimp files with featureCounts, all is fine. With the macaque files, featureCounts starts but then Rstudio just throws a fatal error message which does not provide any details. (see below)

My typical command looks like this:

mac.readcounts = featureCounts("Mac.74.bam",  annot.ext = "Macaca_mulatta.Mmul_8.0.1.92.gtf", isGTFAnnotationFile = T, GTF.attrType = "gene_id", isPairedEnd = T, nthreads = 16L,  strandSpecific = 1)

configuration:
System: Ubuntu 16.04
Rstudio: 1.1.383
R: 3.4.3
Rsubread package: most recent (1.28.1), with all dependencies freshly updated.

Here is the output I see in the console (before the Rstudio error message is displayed):

I'd be grateful for any hint where to look at to solve this.
The only idea I have right now is that it might be somehow related to the fact that the Macaque genome being not too mature, there are a lot more scaffolds/reference chromosomes than in the other two genomes I'm dealing with. (The BAM files for macaque samples have 284728 lines @SQ in the header, and the GTF has 1327 chromosomes.)

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Rstudio throws an error with some samples but not others.
parts:
Thanks for the bug report. It shouldn't be a problem for featureCounts when there are ~300,000 scaffolds in the bam file. featureCounts can process much more scaffolds in a BAM file.

Can you please provide us your BAM file so we can figure what was wrong?

messages.author: bce99ba71cd48eea
messages.subject: Re: Rstudio throws an error with some samples but not others.
parts:
Thanks!

There was a bug in featureCounts when the input BAM file was from STAR or Picard. This bug had been fixed in the 1.29.2 version of our Rsubread package (it was also fixed in Subread-1.6.1 on sourceforge.net). However, the released version of Rsubread (v1.28.1) doesn't have the bug fixed.

The next release of Rsubread should be soon. Before that, you may use samtools to sort the BAM files first (no matter in the read-name order or coordinate order) then run featureCounts on them.

messages.author: c02737bb0ac0a7f0
messages.subject: Re: Rstudio throws an error with some samples but not others.
parts:
Hi Yang,

Thank you, it worked.
I sorted the BAM files by read-name using samtools, and then was able to run featureCounts without issues!

Will update the Rsubread package in my RStudio when the new version comes out.

Cheers,
Alex
